invented.quote: Ten years later, I still haven't gotten back to where I was.

invented.quote: Charter boats land the least flounder in this state.
invented.why: The brief states that charter boats land about 9% and private boats land about 80% of the state's summer flounder, leaving 11% unaccounted for, so it does not show whether another sector lands less than 9%.
